title: session_context input
description: Request envelope for a session-context snapshot (catalog shape `Snapshot`). Advertise-only per RCX Session-Handshake v1: the daemon does not validate invocations against this document, and the field set is open (additive).

session_id.description: Session to snapshot. Defaults to the session bound to the calling plan.

scope.description: Optional scope selector narrowing the snapshot to one state namespace.
